name: Mish-GOE: Mish + Gaussian origin boost
tagline: Standard Mish gating plus a Gaussian bump centred at zero that boosts gradient where post-BatchNorm features concentrate.
diff_from_baseline: Builds on the Mish baseline by adding a localized x·exp(-βx²) term that vanishes for large |x| but lifts the slope near zero; not derivable from GELU or SiLU and contains no learnable parameters.

name: Smooth Leaky ReLU mixture
tagline: Learnable convex combination of linear and Swish-with-sharpness controls, parameterised through softplus and sigmoid for stability.

key_hyperparams.name: phi
key_hyperparams.role: raw param for β (init β=0, pure Swish)

diff_from_baseline: Generalizes the SiLU baseline by interpolating with the identity function via a learnable β, and lets each module learn its own swish sharpness α; unlike GELU/Mish/SiLU baselines it has per-module Parameters.

name: Omni-Swish: contextual Swish
tagline: Self-gated Swish whose gate is a learnable affine combination of pointwise input, 3×3 max/avg neighbourhood and per-channel global mean.
diff_from_baseline: Unlike pointwise SiLU/GELU/Mish baselines, the gate sees a 3×3 spatial neighbourhood plus a per-channel SE-like statistic, making the activation explicitly non-pointwise; degenerates to SiLU at init.

name: VCDG: SiLU + Gaussian bump + neg rescue
tagline: SiLU plus a learnable x·exp(-x²) bump near zero and a soft half-wave term that preserves gradient on negative inputs.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a centred bump and a smooth |x|-style negative term to the SiLU baseline so the activation has nontrivial behaviour both near zero (sharper) and on negatives (gradient-preserving), with two learnable scales rather than the parameter-free SiLU/GELU/Mish references.

name: Adaptive Mish with shift and slope
tagline: Learnable per-module shift α inside softplus and a sharpness β outside, retaining Mish's tanh∘softplus structure.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two learnable scalars to the Mish baseline; β>1 init sharpens the soft region, α gives a horizontal shift — a minimal extension that GELU/SiLU/Mish baselines do not parameterize.
